note: Canonical codegen-primitive vocabulary for the AMD/gfx1100 substrate — the SINGLE source of truth for what the machine search can generate (lowered=true) vs the 'lower all' backlog (lowered=false). model_vocab.py cross-references a model's required primitives against this. A consistency test asserts the lowered dots here == target.dot_primitives_lowered so the two cannot drift. | value = near-term roofline leverage tier (foundational/high/med/low/generality). Per exhaustive-scope philosophy: value ORDERS the work, nothing is closed — every backlog item is eventually built (learning goal), every explored dead-end retains its precise 'reason' as an asset.

primitives.name: reduce
primitives.mechanism: native reduce loop (unfused-reduce OVERHEAD is scheduling, not a missing primitive)

primitives.name: dequant_convert
primitives.mechanism: v_cvt_f32_ubyte — int->float convert (inherent; the decode bottleneck)

primitives.name: v_dot2_f32_f16
primitives.reason: REFUTED for 14B Q4_K decode by roofline-first (2026-07-02, docs/14b-decode-vdot2-roofline-20260702.md): decode arithmetic intensity = 14 FLOP/byte, ~11x BELOW RDNA3's ~148 FLOP/byte balance -> deeply MEMORY-bound. v_dot2 doubles f16-MAC throughput (a COMPUTE lever); doubling compute on a memory-bound streaming GEMV moves the roofline by ~0. Same wall as v_dot4/int-dot but proven a-priori by AI, not post-hoc. Every dot-instruction lever is exhausted for this workload; the frontier is fewer weight BYTES (sub-4-bit, quality-walled) or duty-cycle/attention structure, not faster arithmetic.

primitives.name: fused_reduce_scale
primitives.reason: single-load reduce(x^2)+scale kernel for RMSNorm/qk_norm (not a scheduler tweak). ~2.8% Amdahl.

primitives.name: vec_store_to_reg
primitives.reason: vectorized-V PV primitive — the flash-attention decisive-win blocker; keeps generated attention at near-parity. UOp-spec walled.

primitives.name: coalesced_int8x4_load
primitives.reason: packed int8x4 load so v_dot4 operands arrive packed -> turns the lowered int-dot into a decode win.

primitives.name: scheduler_fuse_elementwise_into_gemv
primitives.mechanism: native scheduler fusion when the GEMV is expressed as Tensor ops (NOT a custom_kernel). DEMONSTRATED (tinygrad c96c5235c): a Tensor-level x->q8_1 quantize fuses into the int-dot GEMV -> 2 kernels (inherent block-max reduce + quantize-divide fused into the dot), bit-exact, integer-space dot (avoids the float convert). The gap is adoption: the production Q4_K GEMV uses a custom_kernel (opaque), which cannot fuse — the fix is to express it as Tensor ops so the scheduler fuses natively.

primitives.name: pm_intdot_tiled_match
primitives.mechanism: RESOLVED (tinygrad c9c520cd6): pm_intdot fires v_dot4 on the realistic fused int-dot GEMV shape (q4 nibble 0-15 x q8 int8), bit-exact, at GEMV scale. The fix was an EXPRESSION RULE not a matcher change: keep each dot operand provably int8-range at the matcher — nibble/quantize via vmin/vmax, and keep the shared quantized-x operand INT8-typed (its realized buffer is int8, so the load carries [-128,127]; an int32 buffer load reports full range and blocks it). 4-chunk reduce structure keeps v_dot4 firing at K=256.

primitives.name: intdot_shape_selective_routing
primitives.reason: route-manifest selects int-dot per-linear only where it wins (large FFN), keep G3 elsewhere.

primitives.name: kv_quant_attention_dequant
primitives.reason: q8/q4 KV-cache dequant path in the flash decode route.

primitives.name: v_dot8_i32_i4
primitives.reason: sudot8 — dots eight 4-bit values (matches Q4_K nibble width exactly); needs i4 packing vocab. Maximal dequant-dot.

primitives.name: v_dot8_u32_u4
primitives.reason: unsigned 8x4-bit dot; needs i4 packing vocab.

primitives.name: v_dot2_f32_bf16
primitives.reason: bf16 dot; not used by qwen3 (no bf16 activations).

primitives.name: ssm_scan
primitives.reason: selective-scan (mamba/hybrid arches, e.g. qwen3.5-27b-hybrid); not qwen3-dense.

primitives.name: ssm_conv
primitives.reason: short causal conv1d for SSM blocks; hybrid arches only.

primitives.name: mma_m16n8k16
primitives.reason: nvidia tensor-core MMA (PTX mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16, sm_80+; f16/bf16 in, f32 accumulate). No CUDA renderer exists in the search, so nothing generates it. Hardware presence is declared by the target, not by this entry.

primitives.name: dp4a
primitives.reason: nvidia 4-way int8 dot accumulating i32 (PTX dp4a, sm_61+). The int8-GEMV counterpart of v_dot4_i32_i8. No CUDA renderer exists in the search, so nothing generates it.
